item.location: prelim.tex (b=nu is Morwani's norm; quadratic neuron at n=2); approach.tex margin definitions 'As in Morwani'
item.statement: L_{2,nu} norm, quadratic neuron (u(a)+v(b))^2 w, and margin definitions g, h, gamma* follow Morwani
item.what_to_check: Match their notation and neuron definition

chk.evidence:
Fetched the arXiv 2311.07568 PDF from https://arxiv.org/pdf/2311.07568 and extracted it with pdftotext. Morwani, Edelman, Oncescu, Zhao, Kakade, ICLR 2024.

1. **The L_{2,ν} norm.** Sec. 2 defines ||θ||_{a,b} = (Σ_i ||ω_i||_a^b)^{1/b}, and homogeneity as φ(λω,x) = λ^ν φ(ω,x). Sec. 3.2 says "we will primarily focus on maximum margin with respect to L2,ν norm in this work". This matches "b=ν is Morwani's norm".

2. **The quadratic neuron.** Sec. 2 gives φ({u,v,w},a,b) = (u_a + v_b)^2 w, with one-hot inputs, no biases and w ∈ R^{|G|}. This is our power neuron at n=2 (ν=3).

3. **The margins.** Sec. 3 defines:
   - g(θ,x,y) = f(θ,x)[y] − max_{y'≠y} f(θ,x)[y'];
   - h(θ) = min_{(x,y)∈D} g;
   - γ* = max_{θ∈Θ} h(θ) with Θ = {||θ|| ≤ 1};
   - the normalized margin as h(θ/||θ||).

   Our h(θ)/||θ||^ν is equal to theirs by ν-homogeneity. Their Theorem 1 restates Wei Thm 4.1 ("any norm, fixed r>0"), which covers our λ||θ||^b.

4. **The class-weighted margin** (g' ≥ g with weights τ) is Sec. 3.2, with Lemmas 5 and 6.

5. **η_{u,v,w}(δ) := E_{a,b}[(u(a)+v(b))^2 w(a+b−δ)]** is defined only in Appendix F.1, not in the main text.

6. **The phase condition** θ_u* + θ_v* = θ_w* is in Thm 7 part 1 (Sec. 4) and App. F.1 Eq. (7).

7. **The maximum margin.** Thm 7: "with m ≥ 4(p−1) neurons. The maximum L2,3-margin ... γ* = sqrt(2/27)·1/(p^{1/2}(p−1))". Parts 1 and 2 give "single frequency per neuron" and "every frequency used".

Every attribution holds. The only issues are section pointers that could be more precise, and the width condition on Thm 7.

Notes are in /Users/ruhaanrajadhyaksha/projects/grok/heracles/paper/litcheck/items/c7-morwani-definitions/CHECK.md.

recommended_citations.why: Supports the L_{2,nu} norm and homogeneity definitions (Sec. 2), the quadratic neuron (u_a+v_b)^2 w (Sec. 2), the definitions of g, h and gamma* (Sec. 3), the class-weighted margin (Sec. 3.2), eta_{u,v,w} (App. F.1), and the Thm 7 value sqrt(2/27)/(p^{1/2}(p-1)) with the phase condition. Title and authors confirmed from the fetched PDF; the existing bib entry is correct.

chk.recommended_change:
These are small precision edits; no attribution is wrong.
(1) approach.tex l.11: change "the quantity $\eta_{u,v,w}(\delta)$ of \citet{morwani2024feature}" to "... of \citet[App.~F.1]{morwani2024feature}". η is defined only in their Appendix F.1.
(2) approach.tex l.7: change "\citep[Section~3]{morwani2024feature}" to "\citep[Section~3.2]{morwani2024feature}", where the class-weighted margin g' ≥ g is introduced.
(3) approach.tex l.70 (and the matching line in appendix.tex): optionally add "(attained at width $m\ge4(p-1)$, their Theorem~7)" after "exactly their maximum $L_{2,3}$-margin". Their value is stated under that width condition.
(4) Optional: in approach.tex l.3, note that Morwani define the normalized margin as h(θ/||θ||), which equals our h(θ)/||θ||^ν by homogeneity. The text already says "by homogeneity", so this is optional.
